title: Window
description: Generic scene window: a markdown body and a list of entries whose labels wrap, each optionally linked. Same look as an ordinary scene window; start here before making a custom prefab.

accent.description: Link underline, host and focus colour.

density.description: Spacing of the body and the entries.

items.description: Entries under the body; labels wrap instead of being cut.

url.description: Opened in a new tab when the entry is activated.

ref.description: Short muted reference on the right.
